sourceRefs.locator: pp. 161–163, especially p. 163 and n. 60. Cyprian of Bordeaux and five further bishops attended both Agde in 506 and Orléans in 511; canon 5 and prisoners.
Opening and attendance paragraphs: 10 July 511 conclusion, the king’s summons, thirty-two bishops and their seven provinces.
Julian and Gregorian calendar rules. 10 July 511 Julian corresponds to 12 July in the proleptic Gregorian calendar used for computation.

original.conversionNote: Two days later in the proleptic Gregorian computation calendar.

note.de: Der Punkt dient der städtischen Orientierung.
Cyprian nahm am Konzil von Orléans teil. Er gehörte bereits in Agde zu den unterzeichnenden Bischöfen.
note.en: Cyprian attended at Orléans, having already been among the signatories at Agde.
